pages.title: Light That Mends
pages.text: A pickaxe bearing Mending takes in a mote of experience, and a crack closes without a scrap of new material.$(br2)Through the lens, I recognize that familiar current. $(l)Experience is another form of aether.$() Dark matter holds a similar pattern within itself.
Those two patterns suggest a way to reclaim aether, and a material that can use it to mend.
